UxPlay 1.74 is distributed with PadMirror as a separate GPLv3 process.

Upstream project: https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay
Bundled revision: 8fa09eaec76a64726fd21becad5dcc82a4c0851c

PadMirror modification: lib/mdnsd/mdnsd.c accepts UXPLAY_MDNS_IPV4 so the
receiver can advertise on the selected physical LAN interface instead of a
lower-metric Hyper-V or WSL adapter.

The corresponding source archive is included in the release bundle. Build it
with MSYS2 UCRT64, CMake and Ninja using -DNO_MARCH_NATIVE=ON.
